Outstanding Food and Service
Aug 2026 • Couples
Located in the old town just off the street that hosts the night market. This place is highly recommended and therefore gets busy. We had to wait about 20 mins for a table but it’s well worth the wait. 
Staff were very attentive and polite-I really cannot recommend them enough . We ordered the spring rolls- a mango salad with prawns and a pork house speciality dish. 
Everything tasted fresh and delicious and we washed it down with a glass of water and a beer for good measure. 
At the end of the meal they serve a fresh fruit which is a nice way to end a fantastic feed.
